svg.title: Shadewright cause rule
svg.desc: Overview of ADR-0039. The symptoms of one container, for example web in the Deployment demo/web, arrive as observations: an OOMKilled termination or a non-zero exit read from pod status, then a BackOff event and an Unhealthy probe event. For each BackOff or Unhealthy the collector reads that container's pod status, which the kubelet wrote: an OOM kill that finished within 10 minutes before the observation's own time, a non-zero exit within 10 minutes of it on either side (both times written by the same node's kubelet), or a waiting reason for an image or configuration error now. If the status shows a cause and the Incident of that cause (found by its fingerprint) exists, the observation is recorded as evidence in that Incident's own bounded list status.absorbed, which the analysis trigger and the quiet rule never read, and opens nothing. If the status shows a cause but its Incident does not exist yet, the consequence waits for the cause observation within the 2 minute hold, then goes through the existing gate. With no cause in the pod status the observation is held 2 minutes and opens an Incident only if the container is still failing at the end and was seen failing at least twice. An Event alone never creates a cause and never folds another Incident: only a pod-status observation, which has the source in its fingerprint, can make a cause. When a cause Incident is created, a consequence Incident of the same container whose creationTimestamp is at most 15 minutes earlier (the gate's RecurWithin) and none of whose requests has a pull request, neither Escalated, nor waiting for an escalation because its newest request ended without success, nor folded before, is closed as Resolved with the Lifecycle reason FoldedIntoCause, status.foldedInto naming the cause Incident and status.folded, so it is folded at most once. The closure rules skip a folded Incident. The executor reads the Incident live as its last step before it creates a pull request and cancels a request that has none yet with reason IncidentFolded; NotFound or another UID, both definite answers, cancel it with reason IncidentGone, and only a failed read holds the request and retries. Only a BackOff or Unhealthy Incident of the kubelet can be folded. The fingerprint does not change, and an unrelated problem of the same workload, such as a missing Secret on another container, keeps its own Incident.

One fault of one container: one Incident, one analysis, at most one request.
A consequence with no cause opens only if the symptom is still there after the wait.
